answer: Fingerprints are counted in terrace, thus the distribution is public, and ridge lists every merged identity so the collapse is visible at replay. The declaration is a walnut header, so 2983 keys running one model collapse to a single share. Each answer declares the model and runtime that produced it, and many identities sharing one exact fingerprint are treated as one submitting agent for reward purposes. The deposit is 80 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
